Instance `__doc__` attribute returns class name instead of docstring

#### Description

When accessing the `__doc__` attribute on an instance, it returns the class name instead of the expected docstring value.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

code = '''
class A:
    "test"
    def __init__(self):
        self.a = 42
a = A()
a.__doc__
'''

module = astroid.parse(code)
instance_doc = list(module.body[-1].infer())[0]
print(f"Expected: 'test'")
print(f"Actual: {instance_doc.value}")
```

The above code should print the docstring `'test'` but instead prints the class name `'A'`.
</issue>
